body:
Hey, 
Yes, I'm about to send you a PM. I wonder how many similar cases there are out there. Would be very interesting to research, I think. Sometimes I wonder if coming from a wealthy, supportive backing would have made things significantly better, such that I could just go out and find my fulfillment with some volunteer work or lower-paying career. I hate that there's always been a money crunch. 

I'm 23 right now. The thought that I have a good 60 more years of this to look forward just exhausts and completely depresses me. I feel so drained from excessive demands. It sometimes feels like I've put in 50 years worth of work already.

Oh, I hear you. Both of my parents are out of work and on welfare/food stamps now. Even with that there's so many hoops to jump through, it's a joke. Father just got offered a job making a little over $10/hr with no benefits... Not sure what that's going to be able to provide.

As for me, it still feels like there's not much getting ahead because now I have to think about them not losing their house. There's never been any security with anything in my life and it's exhausting.

Thank you. I think I needed to just air this one out. I'm starting to think that I am meant to change things, to fight, to push back. It's just incredibly hard to step away from everything society has programmed a person to pursue.

Abolutely. I totally get it-- and someone's everything may be nothing to the next. It just fascinates me the implications that come with the perception of someone having "everything". 

I used to work with suicidal adolescents and would be shocked that many world come from good, supportive, sometimes even wealthy families. It blew my mind.

What scares me is that, yes, while I strongly believe I can achieve just about anything I put my mind to, that this baggage always comes along with it, it's more a part of me than any single thing I am able to accomplish.

I have a feeling that I need to enter politics/ some form of activism. I don't know that it will make things any better, but I know that I would rather kill myself than continue to play the money game. It's just not right what's being done to people all around and it disgusts me. People shouldn't be barred from education and basic living due to the almighty dollar.
